name: Mok'thardin's Enchantment
summary: At Grom'gol Base Camp, Far Seer Mok'thardin gathers materials for a shamanistic ritual. With feline trophies collected, he now seeks feathers from Stranglethorn Vale's raptors.

sections.title: Feathers of the Stalker
sections.body: Far Seer Mok'thardin still needs more before his shamanistic ritual can begin. He is gathering materials for a tool to aid the Warchief. Now he asks you to bring feathers worn by Jungle Stalkers. The raptors live in the dense jungle south of Grom'gol Base Camp, near the great arena.

faq.q: Who is asking for the feathers?
faq.answer: Far Seer Mok'thardin, an orc shaman at Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale, seeks feathers for a ritual enchantment.

faq.q: Where are the Jungle Stalkers located?
faq.answer: Jungle Stalkers live in the jungle directly south of Grom'gol Base Camp, near the Gurubashi Arena.

faq.q: Why does Far Seer Mok'thardin need Jungle Stalker feathers?
faq.answer: Mok'thardin uses a shamanistic ritual to combine jungle curiosities and beast trophies into an enchanted tool meant to aid the Horde and the Warchief.
Before this request, you helped Mok'thardin hunt the Vale's feline beasts and gather the first components for his planned enchantment.

angles.text: Far Seer Mok'thardin means the finished enchantment to aid the Horde and the Warchief.
As a shaman, you know Mok'thardin combines jungle trinkets with his ritual to make an enchanted item.
